title: Estrus Jetson Pipeline
tagline: Edge inference on NVIDIA Jetson with multi-RTSP ingestion
intro: An edge AI pipeline delivering real-time estrus alerts from multiple farm cameras.
summary: Optimized inference on NVIDIA Jetson devices with hardware acceleration, multi-camera RTSP ingestion, and on-device alerting. Synced structured data to Firebase and assets to Cloud Storage.
features: Firebase for structured data; GCS for archival

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A production-oriented edge pipeline connecting multiple IP cameras to Jetson devices for real-time inference and alerting.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Reduce cloud dependence and latency by running estrus detection directly at the edge.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Designed the Jetson pipeline, integrated multi-RTSP streams, optimized inference, and hardened for on-site reliability.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Demonstrated feasible, low-latency detection in real farm scenarios with improved reliability.
